pending-clause.answer: §2002:7.1 differs from 2023 in the processing steps (2023 adds COBOL-WORDS and PUSH/POP steps), in step numbering, and in 2023's licence to prohibit non-COBOL characters in text-words. The rule does not rest on any of that: 2002 7.1 itself requires alphanumeric, boolean and national literals to be syntactically correct in the initial text, so they are recognized as literals before REPLACE applies, and SR7 bars them as partial words. Scope and the rp-lit1/2/3 evidence at 2002 are unchanged.
